description: Override heartbeat model to use local qwen3.5:4B instead of cloud glm-5.2 for CMO agent, saving cloud token costs on routine monitoring heartbeats
rationale: CMO heartbeat runs every 30 minutes (48 times/day) purely for infrastructure checks: posting queue status, LinkedIn token validity, scheduler log health, and cron job presence. These are simple shell commands with pass/fail output parsing. The local model (qwen3.5:4B) handles this easily. Using glm-5.2:cloud for these checks wastes cloud tokens. Cloud model still used for: content creation (Sundays), campaign strategy, user conversations, cross-agent coordination, escalations. HEARTBEAT.md has been rewritten to be explicit and structured for the local model's capability level with clear if/then decision trees.
risk_assessment: LOW — heartbeat model override only affects automated polling runs. Interactive sessions still use primary model (glm-5.2:cloud). If local model struggles with a check, it escalates per HEARTBEAT.md protocol. No risk to content creation, posting, or other agent functionality.
backup_plan: If local model heartbeats cause issues, remove the model override to revert to cloud model for all heartbeats.
